notes: Black-box measurement of the group of gateways on real Linux VMs of one lab host (one VM per node, HAProxy on a balancer VM, nftables for the edge and for faults, a TUN based delay in place of netem). Development build of schild, never a release. Not the testlab profiles pair and fleet of the spec. Report: tests/results/MVP-27-lab-run2.md.
